messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we need to align on acceptance criteria for the enterprise compliance launch (BYOK/KMS + audit retention). Customers keep asking for both long retention and predictable pricing. TL;DR: what's required for MVP vs. stretch?
Ajay: For MVP I think: 1) BYOK handshake, 2) per-tenant retention TTL config, 3) exportable audit bundle. Keep it small.
Oliver: +1, and add: immutable write-ahead audit log for 90 days searchable (indexing optional). Full search is a later effort.
Priya: Ops note — retention affects storage cost and backup windows. If we allow arbitrary long TTLs we need cold-archive integration or tiered pricing.
Maria: Right — product tradeoff: ship broad BYOK + short retention vs. delayed long-retention feature. Customers asking for 7 years though.
Darren: Legal/customer asks: some contracts demand 7y retention and chain-of-custody export. Can we provide exportable evidence for >90d while storing compressed snapshots in cold archive?
Ajay: Implementation idea: support two modes — "operational retention" (default 90d, searchable) and "evidence snapshots" (archived, notarized exportable blobs). Evidence snapshots can be produced on-demand or scheduled.
Maria: That lets us hit SOC2 evidence needs without full-text search on old data. Good. What's KMS/BYOK acceptance criteria?
Oliver: BYOK acceptance criteria (S1): KMS handshake + rotation handling + proof of possession logs. S2 (stretch): HSM-backed key import and escrow.
Priya: Ops acceptance criteria: we must be able to rotate keys and re-encrypt metadata without downtime for Dedicated customers. Also key compromise playbook documented.
Maria: Can we map these into launch gates? Proposal: Gate A (MVP): BYOK handshake, per-tenant TTL, 90d searchable audit log, export API for evidence snapshots. Gate B (post-MVP): 1y searchable, cold-archive + lifecycle policies, key escrow/HSM support.
Ajay: Timeline-wise, Gate A needs runtime changes (kv caching eviction + tiered storage flag), and a small export job. Estimate: 3 sprints eng (2 backend, 1 infra).
Oliver: Security review checklist: threat model updates, KMS API threat tests, audit trail integrity tests, key-rotation regression tests. Blocker if missing.
Priya: Operationally we need metrics and alerting for snapshot backlog and archive ingestion failures. Also cost-metering per customer for long-retention storage — Finance will want usage tags.
Maria: Good call. Finance ask: we need a simple pricing knob for long retention (per-GB/month for archived evidence).
Darren: Legal: export format must include signatures, timestamping, and a manifest with key fingerprints. That reduces disputes.
Ajay: Prototype export manifest shape:```
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "snapshot_ts": "2026-05-02T12:00:00Z",
  "sha256": "...",
  "kms_key_fingerprint": "AB:CD:...",
  "items": ["audit.log.2026-04-01", "evidence/meta.json"]
}
```
Maria: Nice. For SLA language: we can commit to retention durability (SLA) and best-effort search latency on archived data. Do we want a customer-facing SLA for search over 1y?
Priya: Not for MVP. We should list search over archive as best-effort with an option to pay for expedited restores.
Oliver: Also list fallback model: if KMS unavailable we should have an emergency key-rotation fallback with ops approvals (documented GRC flow).
Maria: Action items: 1) Ajay — draft technical spec for Gate A export + retention flags (due EOW). 2) Oliver — produce security checklist and minimal tests (due next Wed). 3) Priya — ops runbook + metrics list (due next Fri). 4) Darren — confirm legal export contents and required retention durations for top 3 customers (due EOW).
Ajay: I'll include cost estimates and an engineering rollout plan. Will call out migration steps for existing tenants.
Priya: I'll add alert thresholds and a billing tag proposal.
Oliver: I'll flag any high-risk items that block Gate A.
Maria: If everyone is aligned we'll present Gate A acceptance criteria at the weekly product review. Final ask: we should capture two example contracts (one 90d, one 7y) to validate spec.
pm-bot: Reminder scheduled: product-review sync on 2026-05-05 16:00. :calendar:
Maria: Thanks team — short check-in next Tue if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
